# dashboardcn source

The components in this directory are adapted from [dashboardcn at b1ffacb](https://github.com/noahgdev/dashboardcn/tree/b1ffacbca0f7a0be60135c8665b9e8c267205c48) under the accompanying MIT license. The registry files come from `apps/web/registry/dashboardcn`. The card and chart support components are the shadcn/ui-derived files in `apps/web/components/ui`.

Falcon supplies scoped design tokens, HeroUI utilities and tooltips, and the existing Recharts runtime. Chart colors use inline CSS custom properties and the trend chart exposes point selection for Falcon drill-down.
